parsedVerdict.reasoning: src/application serves one concern: it runs the task-management use cases on top of domain repositories. The files split into use case classes, an outbound IdGenerator port, a shared TaskFinderService and the DTO mappers in dto.ts, and they use these consistently. The task-in-project check lives only in TaskFinderService.findInProject, and both use cases that change a task call it instead of reimplementing it. Every use case that creates an entity gets IDs from IdGenerator, and every result is built by a dto.ts mapper. The one gap is minor: AddTaskUseCase and ListTasksUseCase each repeat the project-exists lookup (findById followed by a not-found error). No shared helper for this exists, so nothing is bypassed, and a two-line guard is not enough to fail cohesion.
